text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, a data analyst with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization.

I’d love to help Hood iQ turn data into practical product and strategy insights. My background aligns well with building clear, reliable analysis pipelines and dashboards that support decision-making. In a recent confidential SaaS project, I built monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan, plus an onboarding funnel using SQL, PostgreSQL, Python, pandas, and Looker Studio. One key result was identifying an onboarding step linked to 40% of first-month churn.

I’m interested in applying that same analytical rigor to asset quantification, trading metrics, and compliance-focused reporting. I’d be glad to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
